resources.string: Save Home row order and limits, browsing appearance, subtitle appearance, autoplay, prerolls and seek lengths.

Restores apply only to the current account on this TV. Backups contain no account identifiers, server addresses, passwords or tokens. Library settings, pinned shortcuts, recommendations, watch history, playlists, other playback settings and device capability overrides are excluded.
Save a JSON backup in Downloads/LumaFin on this TV. Use a file manager to retrieve it.
This TV has no system file picker. Use Restore a saved backup for files saved by LumaFin, or install a document-provider app to import a file from elsewhere.
No file selected. No settings changed. If this TV has no file picker, use Restore a saved backup for files saved by LumaFin.
%1$d changes • %2$d already match • %3$d unsupported entries skipped. Settings missing from the backup stay as they are.
Apply %3$d changes to %1$s on %2$s? Other accounts keep their settings.
Backup saved in Downloads/LumaFin. Copy this JSON file somewhere safe for use on another TV or after reinstalling.
Backup saved to the selected file.
No saved backups found. Import a backup file or save one first.
Unable to review this backup. It may be invalid, too large, from an unsupported version, or the current account may have changed. No settings were changed.
Unable to save or read settings. Check that you are signed in and the file location is available.
Restore could not be completed. Reopen the backup if the account or settings changed during review.
Settings restored. Close settings and reopen Home to see your layout.
